clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, Neeru Fireblade studies dark arts he says can protect the Horde. Margoz sends you from Durotar with a Searing Collar taken from the Burning Blade cult, hoping the warlock can explain its demonic power.

Margoz has found the limit of shamanic arts. The collars taken from Burning Blade cultists at Skull Rock carry demonic sorcery, beyond what he can unravel. Shamans draw on the elements and ancestral spirits, so Margoz sends you to a warlock in the capital to learn what the collars do.

Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow lies beneath its red cliffs. Warlocks and other practitioners of forbidden magic work there under Thrall's wary eye. Neeru Fireblade lives in the cavern and says he studies fel power to thwart demonic threats. When you bring him the collar, his curiosity turns Durotar's investigation toward the warlock enclave.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Searing Collars you brought me are powerful, demonic implements. Divining their origin is, I'm afraid, beyond my skills as a shaman. We will need a warlock to study them.

Take a searing collar to Neeru Fireblade. Although he is a skilled warlock, he professes to use his powers to thwart demons, and claims his research in the occult is benign. Be that true or false, we may need his aid against the demonic cult in Durotar.
You may find Neeru in Orgrimmar in the Cleft of Shadow.

clips.title: Progress
paras: My most humble greetings, adventurer. How might I help my traveler friend today?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, and where did you get this? Good Margoz in Razor Hill sent you to me, did he?
Well, let me take a closer look...
